playlist.title: Squelch & Soul — The Acid Thread Through the Garage Lineage
playlist.description: The TB-303 and its squelchy analogue kin, traced not through acid house proper but through the soulful lineage: soul, disco, garage, the Jersey sound, soulful/deep house, garage house, UK garage, speed garage, 2-step, bassline and their near neighbours — 1983 to today, dancefloor cuts only. Every track anchored to a real Discogs release page; YouTube links sourced from those pages. Built with the discogs-playlist skill.
